title: Yang-Lee Criticality as a Dissipative Dynamical Phase Transition: Quantum Simulation of non-Hermitian Physics without Post-selection
abstract: Realizes the d+0 dimensional Yang-Lee theory (Ising spins in imaginary field) without post-selection in a (d-1)+1 open system of local unitaries plus engineered dissipation. The generator of the relevant linear observables is the non-Hermitian Yang-Lee transfer matrix; spin correlators and a Loschmidt-echo correlator of the Yang-Lee theory are directly measurable. Dissipation built from local 2-qubit gates; generalizes to embedding arbitrary non-Hermitian Hamiltonians in Lindbladian dynamics.
key_claims: Yang-Lee criticality realized as an underdamped/overdamped dynamical transition without post-selection
Yang-Lee correlation functions measurable on near-term simulators with local 2-qubit dissipation
relevance_note: Abstract only. A hardware route for Yang-Lee physics that avoids exponential post-selection cost, relevant if HYP-028 ever wants an experimental leg. Does not supply lattice CFT data or touch the c vs c_eff question.
